description_en: Adds the EIP or VIP of a zone back to DNS resolution
description_zh: 将可用区对应的EIP/VIP加回到域名解析中
kebab_example: aliyun nlb cancel-shift-load-balancer-zones --zone-mappings ZoneId=cn-hangzhou-a VSwitchId=vsw-sersdf0000 --load-balancer-id nlb-83ckzc8d4xlp8o0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CancelShiftLoadBalancerZones

fields.help_en: The vSwitch that corresponds to the zone. By default, each zone uses one vSwitch and one subnet
fields.help_zh: 可用区对应的交换机，每个可用区默认使用一台交换机和一个子网
fields.name: vswitch_id

fields.help_en:
The zone ID of the NLB instance.
You can add back at most one zone in a single call.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443890.html operation to query zone IDs
fields.help_zh:
NLB实例的可用区ID。
一次调用最多支持加回一个可用区。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443890.html接口获取可用区ID
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of zone and vSwitch mappings.

You can add back at most one zone in a single call
parameters.help_zh:
可用区及交换机映射列表。

一次调用最多支持加回一个可用区
parameters.name: zone_mappings

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only precheck the request. Valid values:
true: sends a precheck request without adding the zone back. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and service limits are met. If the request fails the precheck, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the precheck, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): sends a regular request. If the request passes the precheck, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会加回可用区。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate the value from your client. Make sure that the value is unique across different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the NLB instance. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
NLB实例所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
